description: Render slides you already wrote, 1-25 (X portrait posts take up to 20 images). Use when you have the content from the user’s files, images, or research. GenPPT skips its own outline and designs exactly your slides, then renders full-resolution images (paid plans; Free stops at the concept preview). Make every slide visual: pass websiteUrls or per-slide screenshotUrl to show live webpage screenshots, imageUrl for logos and product UI, unsplashQuery for a real photo, and name the brands to show as logos. Returns at once; call genppt_get_deck with waitSeconds. Uses one deck from the plan allowance.

artDirection.description: Palette, typography, layout, brand, safe zones, or poster style for every slide.

aspectRatio.description: Slide shape. Default '4:5'. '4:5' or '3:4' = X 20-image portrait posts, LinkedIn PDF carousels, Instagram feed carousels. '9:16' = TikTok Photo Mode, Instagram Reels and Stories. '2:3' = Pinterest. '1:1' = square threads and posts. '16:9' = widescreen decks. '4:3' and '3:2' = classic screens and photo prints.

attachmentUrls.description: Public URLs (up to 20) of PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, MD files, or YouTube videos whose text content the slides use (pass visual style/brand image URLs via referenceImageUrls instead).

autoRender.description: Default true: render full slides right after the concept. false = stop at the concept preview.

isPublic.description: Optional. Set true to publish a shareable read-only link at /s/<slug>. Defaults to false (or true on the GenPPT showcase account).

referenceImageUrls.description: Public image URLs (first 4 used) for the whole deck: brand logos, marks, or visual style exemplars. Put portraits and slide-specific images on slides[].imageUrl instead.

slides.description: The slides in order. Slide 1 is the cover or hook.

imageUrl.description: Public image URL to show on this slide: a person portrait, brand logo, product UI screenshot, chart, or photo. Do not repeat it in referenceImageUrls. Ignored when screenshotUrl is set.

purpose.description: What this slide must say: the claim, facts, numbers, and copy to show.

screenshotUrl.description: Public webpage URL that GenPPT screenshots live and shows on this slide in a browser frame: a product page, article, dashboard, or tweet.

unsplashQuery.description: Short search for one real stock photo for this slide: a real place, building, landscape, or generic setting, such as "trader at desk with monitors". Omit it for historical objects, metaphors, and data diagrams; GenPPT draws those. Used only when neither screenshotUrl nor imageUrl is set.

visual.description: Layout and imagery: the real proof on the slide. Framed webpage or app screenshot, recognizable brand logos and app icons, real photo, labeled chart, UI window, or one bold tactile object as a visual metaphor. Never a text-only card.

thesis.description: The core argument of the slideshow in one sentence.

websiteUrls.description: Public webpages (up to 6) that GenPPT screenshots live before rendering, so real product, article, or dashboard UI appears in the deck. A page goes on the slide that names its domain; the rest guide the whole deck.

name: genppt_create_slideshow
title: Create slideshow
